decisions: White-space analysis is deterministic and local: explicit absence/under-coverage cues are converted to WhiteSpaceCandidate objects with stable document provenance.
The engine classifies candidates as research, patent or market using explicit metadata/text first, then document kind; callers can filter by type or topic.
Resolved language such as fills, closes or directly addresses a gap is excluded; unsupported free-form claims are not promoted without a white-space cue.
The existing WhiteSpaceCandidate contract is reused without touching storage, legacy CRIBA, BLACKFORGE goldens or SUPRA.
remaining_risks: Cue extraction is English and sentence-based; it does not infer latent gaps from statistical cluster density.
Patent and market classification is heuristic unless space_type is supplied in metadata or as a filter.
limitations: No network, external dependencies, database writes or production artifacts were used.
The unrelated pre-existing docs/FINAL_REPORT.md, .pre-commit-config.yaml, docs/TOOLCHAIN.md, docs/architecture/ and scripts/verify-dev-environment.* remain untouched and uncommitted.
